# Every report key a console is known to send, one per line.
#
# The Ecowitt-protocol names follow the field map in Home Assistant's aioecowitt library
# (Apache-2.0), the most complete public list; the Wunderground-protocol names follow the
# weewx-interceptor driver; the console metadata fields (`stationtype`, `model`, `freq`) are
# from recorded payloads, since neither lists them. test_fields requires each key to map to
# exactly one field spec, so a key that silently fell through to the unmapped table would
# fail the suite.
